assumptions: Requested expansion covers vanilla construction and redstone; all *_ORE and ancient debris stay blocked on planning and revalidation.

100/1000/10000 changed blocks per player-day and 1/5/20 players are low/base/high illustrative upper-throughput scenarios, not measured income. Existing per-operation/hour permissions and limits remain unchanged.

Every replace consumes exact construction items and returns the old construction items; counts including slabs and candles remain unchanged. Undo reverses the same exchange. No random drops, rewards, prices or earning multiplier are added.

vault and tokens direct mint remain zero; existing optional shop purchase stays an unchanged debit. Existing operation telemetry/contract progress limits remain unchanged. No new player BlockPlace or BlockBreak events are fired.
EconomyShopGUI SELL remains current/conditional as recorded in canonical inventory; planned removal and contract transition are unchanged. No investment or SHADOW income is assumed.

Physics may produce vanilla drops from unsupported neighboring blocks; no journal rollback is allowed after committed physics, to avoid restoring both blocks and drops. Undo must fail closed if physics changed the expected block state.
